title: Foreign diplomats to be taken to Rēzekne for investment pep talk
summary_full: On 30th October, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, in cooperation with the Latgale Planning Region, is organising a regional visit to Rēzekne for diplomats from foreign embassies, the Ministry said.
